scope: Six preselected benchmark source/target pairs, all four views; generated predictions not yet reviewed.

records.instruction: Add a power cord extending from the base
records.observation: Lamp: target includes a cord from base; target body has visible pose/shape differences.

records.instruction: Add a crafted lid with a small knob on top of the vase
records.observation: Vase: target has lid and knob; some views show tilt/body deformation.

records.instruction: Add a roof luggage rack on top of the limousine
records.observation: Limousine: target has roof rack, source body mostly retained in silhouette.
Sumo figure: topknot absent in target; body largely retained.
Stylized object: grip absent, other body details/pose differ slightly.
Container: lid absent and interior exposed; rim/interior has artifacts.

limitations: Target body/pose differences may contribute to global distances; no independent alignment or ICP will be applied.
